advice: Abstain. In the active panel32 loop, each loaded A vector and each loaded B vector already feed two FMOPA operations, covering the output tile with the four available ZA tiles. Reusing either operand across another K step would be invalid because the values differ; holding more vectors across steps adds register pressure without reducing the required input loads. The prior evidence identifies no distinct register-reuse experiment.
risks: Further reuse claims would duplicate existing work or change load scheduling, which is a separate experiment. The earlier active-path scheduling changes did not pass promotion; their noisy outcomes do not establish why. No new checks or measurements are proposed.
